title: Cascade Tranches & Capacity Runway Simulator
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Create a lightweight interactive simulator and decision canvas that lets PMs and engineering leads model multi-tranche cycle commits (core, stretch, surge) across people pools. The tool should surface: capacity runway in engineering-weeks, recommended tranche sizes for each initiative, what-if staffing swap outcomes, and guarded scope-cut suggestions when headroom is low. Deliver a v0 that is a spreadsheet-driven simulator plus a short playbook describing interpretation and run rules.
acceptance_criteria: A v0 simulator (Google Sheet) that models 8 workstreams, skill pools, and 3 tranche tiers with adjustable staffing and velocity inputs
Playbook doc with 6-step decision flow and example scenarios (onboarding, mid-cycle surge, unexpected departures)
At least three scenario run outputs: baseline, -20% FTE sudden loss, and +2 temporary contractors, with recommended scope-cut actions
Stakeholder review completed with Eng leads, Design PM, and People Operations and decisions captured
Simulator links and playbook referenced in the Cycle Planning runbook and linked from the cycle kickoff checklist
notes: Motivation: current cycle overcommit issues happen when initiatives are planned independently; this canvas enforces a shared runway view
We will prioritize pragmatic signals over perfect forecasting: focus on simple inputs (FTEs, weekly throughput per role, percent allocation) rather than full JIRA ticket models
Avoid building a full web app in v0; deliver value quickly with a maintainable spreadsheet and automation hooks for later
Coordinate with ENG-284910 for velocity benchmarks and with People Ops for realistic allocation curves
